# Legacy Runner wheelhouse

This directory is a compatibility build input for the legacy Runner only. The
old wheel hashes and mission lock instructions are preserved in the
[archived wheelhouse guide](../../../docs/archive/legacy-mission-workflows/applications/runner-vendor-README.md).
The new App runtime uses the separately packaged local wheels documented in
[`docs/python-distribution.md`](../../../docs/python-distribution.md).
